content: Nsim a un'köön
Ilä akin, Yɛsu kàtoo u ndwà, waa kàkàbwaay ukɔl a ɛwà.
Iköŋ a baar kyàyàkwo tsütsü apà nde, nde kàbilà u bwaar, waa kàbwaay. Un'sɛŋ a baar wanswà kàkäl u nkankyel.
Nde kàyääm anà ba indiir mbɔɔn u nsim, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Ilä mwɛy, un'köön mwɛy kàkyer atoo mukàkɔn mbɛŋ u ywaŋ ande.
Umpal kàmwɛŋ nde ya, yar làmwɛy làbü ukɔl a mbwo: nɛn a du laa yàyi ya, waa yàdi ya.
Yar lumwɛy làbü udu a in'kul mpa myàkäl anà mɛɛn mbɔɔn. Mbɛŋ yàmɛn agyägyä, ntɔn mɛɛn màkäl itääŋ.
Wɛɛ umpal kàbalà mwäänà, bite waa byàkuŋà, byàyöm, ntɔn bya byàkäl anki anà in'swɛy.
Yar lumwɛy làbü uboo a nsyeenà: nsyeenà yàyɛl ya, laa yàküünà ya bite aŋàbwaŋ.
Wɛɛ mbɛŋ yumwɛy yàbü udu a mɛɛn aŋàbwaŋ, waa byàbör imfà: imwɛy nkam, kyumwɛy an'kwem an'syaam, kyumwɛy an'kwem an'tär.
Wɛy mbuur awe anà an'tsü awem uwem! »
Ntɔn nkye Yɛsu uyisyääl nde nsim?
Apan, alɔŋki bàyàsin apà nde, waa bun'fuul naa: « Ntɔn nkye ayiyääm ngye anà ba u nsim? »
Nde kafuur naa: « Bɛ, bɛ làkyàwal an'yeerà a inkuu a imfum a du, wɛɛ ba, ba ma bàwɛl anki.
Mbuur awe anà undiir, nde bàkyer asun'pà, waa nde usàkal abyà mbɔɔn, wɛɛ akà mbuur mpa awe anà wa, bàsàlwom itàkal undiir awe nde awà.
Undiir awun in'fàyääm mɛ anà ba unsà nsim: Ntɔn, ba bàmulerà ukɔɔn aman, anà bàmulɛɛ tsü ukɔɔn awem anà ukɔɔn ayöb.
Abun, ngɔɔm kàtɛ Yɛsay wà kan'kwo ntɔn ba:

content.text: "Bɛ làsàwem ubwaŋàbwaŋ, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làsàyöb anki,
bɛ làsàler ubwaŋàbwaŋ, wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làsàman anki.
Ntɔn mpem a un'sɛŋ awà yàkyàbwà ikwabà,
abun ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n abuul mpem, anà mɛ in'kɔ̈ɔ̈n akɔɔr." »

content: « Wɛɛ akà bɛ, bɛ làbà unsà un'sak, ntɔn mii abɛ myà mutäälà anà an'tsü abɛ mà muweemà!
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, aŋangɔɔm anà baar a balàbal mbɔɔn bàlàkwen muman ndaa ayà làmanà bɛ yi, wɛɛ ba ya bàsàman anki, muwem ndaa làweemà bɛ yi, wɛɛ ba ya bàsàwem anki. »
Mbuul a nsim a un'köön
« Mpalabà, làwem mbuul a itim a un'köön.
Isàkal naa mbuur kan'wem ndaa a Imwol, wɛɛ nde ya uyöbà anki, imɛnà naa mbuur un'be kan'yà anà kan'lwom ndaa bàkön u mpem ande. Nde wà asànaa mbɛŋ yàbü ukɔl a mbwo.
Baar bumwɛy bà asànaa yar a mbɛŋ alà làbü u mɛɛn a in'kul, wà mbuur kan'wal Ndaa agyägyä unsà un'sak.
Wɛɛ uboo ande in'swɛy myatɛy, nde wà mbuur a ansɔŋà: isàkal naa lingyoomà lan'yà itàkal nkwaaŋ ntɔn Ndaa, laa ubwà nde.
Mbɛŋ ayà bàkön uboo a nsyeenà, yà asànaa mbuur kan'wem Ndaa, wɛɛ nkyän a indiir a mɛɛn mà anà ndɛb a in'naaŋ laa iküünà bya Ndaa, waa ya mpa ibɔr imbɛŋ.
Yar bàkön u mɛɛn aŋàbwaŋ, là baar bàfàwem Ndaa anà bàfàyöb ya. Apan ba bàfàbɔr mbɛŋ: amwɛy nkam, bumwɛy an'kwem an'syaam, bumwɛy an'kwem an'tär. »
Nsim a un'lɛŋ un'be
Yɛsu kàfatɛɛl nsim asin: « Imwol a du kyà asànaa mbuur mwɛy kàkön imbɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ u ywaŋ ande.
Wɛɛ utaaŋ bàkäl baar mubɔ̈ɔ̈n, un'yiiŋ ande waa kàyi, waa kàkön iteerà uboo a blɛ, laa kàkyen nde.
Mpal làyɛl blɛ anà imfà byàsɛmà bya mutoo, iteerà sye waa byàyàsɛnà mbwo mwɛy anà bya.
Asyääl a ŋaywaŋ bayi mukun'fuul naa: "Nkum, nkye kà imbɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ anki ngye kàkön u ywaŋ angye? Wɛɛ iteerà binà byan'fà ken?"
Nde kafuur naa: "Un'yiiŋ mwɛy kàkyer abun." Asyääl waa bun'fuul naa: "Nkye ngye akyàkwen naa bi ikàlwom bya?"
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: "Aay, manà bɛ làyàkàtsuum blɛ mbwo mwɛy anà iteerà.

Làwɛy bya byàbyeel byàyɛl mbwo mwɛy tii u paŋà abwo bya. Mpal ayin mɛ in'sàtɛn a abweel naa: Tàlalwoomà iteerà, làbäm bya ibiŋ ntɔn musà bya mbaa. Ungö, làbwe imfà, làsi blɛ unsà ikɔr amɛ." »
Nsim a imbɛŋ ikikye
Yɛsu kàfatɛɛl nsim asin naa: « Imwol a du kyà asànaa mbuur mwɛy kan'wal imbɛŋ ikikye anà kan'kɔn kya u ywaŋ ande.
Imbɛŋ aki kyà imbɛŋ mwɛy kyan'söön ukye uboo a mbɛŋ yanswà. Wɛɛ kya isàyɛl, kya ifàbulà un'te mwɛy wà kölàköl. Apan, nɛn a du iyàtɔŋ an'yaab aya kan'kɔkà a wa. »
Nsim a ful
Yɛsu kàfatɛɛl nsim asin naa: « Imwol a du kyà asànaa ful kàwɛl un'kaar mwɛy anà kàbünà nde anà an'kɔɔb an'tär mà mfufu a mampà. Ungö apan mfar yanswà waa yàfül. »
Ntɔn nkye Yɛsu kàyisyäälà nde nsim mbɔɔn
Ndaa ayin yanswà Yɛsu ba ya kakyäänà u nsim, akà ndaa mwɛy yatɛy kàtɛɛnà nde anà ba ukɔɔn nsim,
ntɔn ndaa ayà kàtɛn ŋangɔɔm ikwe:

content.text: « Mɛ in'sàduub mun amɛ mutà nsim,
mɛ in'sakyään indiir aŋàyee sɛmà bàkyer mɛɛn. »

content: Mbuul a nsim a iteerà
Apan Yɛsu kàsàwɛy iköŋ a baar, waa kàkyen ndwà. Alɔŋki ande bàsin apà nde, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Ibuul nsim a iteerà uboo a ywaŋ. »
Nde kafuur abà: « Mbuur afàkɔn imbɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ, Mwan a mbuur,
ywaŋ là mɛɛn mà, imbɛŋ aŋàbwaŋ bà baan abà uboo a Imwol, iteerà ikaswaŋà baan a Mbuur un'be.
Ŋankir kàkön iteerà wà ileŋ, mbweel a imbɛŋ yà ntsüü a mɛɛn mà, wɛɛ abweel bà akyeey.
Abun, asànaa bàfàtsuum iteerà ntɔn musà bya mbaa, ya sye isàkal abwɛy u ntsüü a mɛɛn:
Mwan a mbuur asàtɔm akyeey ande mulwom uboo a Imwol ande, ndaa yanswà ifàsiinà baar mukyer ube anà baar bàfàyweer ndaa a mbe,
waa bàsatɔɔm u yaaŋ a mbaa. Akun ntsü isàkal ilel anà nkwoor a an'din.
Apan, baar a balàbal bàsàtà in'nyäŋ uboo a Imwol a Taaràba asànaa taaŋ. Wɛy mbuur awe anà an'tsü awem uwem! »
Undiir a ntal aŋàyee anà làpɛr

« Imwol a du kyà asànaa undiir a ntal wàŋàyee u mɛɛn uboo a ywaŋ làmwɛy, waa mbuur mwɛy kàmɛn wa: nde kan'fàyee wa. Unsà un'sak, nde waa ukyà, uyälà indiir ande byanswà ntɔn musom ywaŋ alà. »
« Le, Imwol a du kyan'kwo ifàkal asànaa un'tɛɛl a an'yà ayileŋ mpɛr aŋàbwaŋ.
Utaaŋ kàmɛn nde làpɛr làmwɛy làntal a kölàköl, nde kàkàyälà indiir ande byanswà ntɔn musom làpɛr alà. »
Nsim a an'tɛy
« Imwol adu kyan'kwo bàfàsi anà an'tɛy mwɛy ban'tɔɔm kà ɛwà anà man'siim nsö a ifà ifà.
Ma isàyɔl, alɔ̈ɔ̈b waa bànaan ma u nkankyel, waa bàbwaay, bàsà nsö aŋàbwaŋ uboo a un'lwaŋ, waa bàpiy indiir ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ.
Ya sye isàkal abun u ntsüü a mɛɛn: akyeey bàsàyà ntɔn mukaab baar abe anà baar a balàbal,
waa bàsàtɔɔm baar abe u yaaŋ a mbaa. Akun ntsü isàkal ilel anà nkwoor a an'din. »
In'naaŋ akün anà myà itaan
Abun, Yɛsu kafuul naa: « Nkye bɛ, bɛ làkiyöbà indiir abi byanswà? » Ba bàfuur naa: « Ɛɛ »
Nde kakyään naa: « Lalan, un'lɔɔŋ a un'kɔɔn wanswà kan'wal an'yeerà unsà Imwol a du, asàkal asànaa ŋandwà mwɛy afàwal indiir akün anà byà itaan uboo a un'naaŋ ande. »
Baar a Nasàlɛr ban'tɔn musà làkwikilà amu Yɛsu
Mpal kàmay Yɛsu mutɛn unsà nsim, nde kàlwomà kà ikal akin.
Apan nde kàkyen nsi ande, waa kàlɔɔŋà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà aba. Baar bàkäl pa bàkyer abem, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « An'yeerà ande amà anà impà abi byan'fà ken?
Nkye nde kà mwan a sharpantye anki? Nkye ngwän ande kà Màlye anki? Nkye Zyak, Yɔsɛfi, Simɔn anà Yude kà atɔŋ ande anki?
Nkye ampääŋ ande banswà kà bà uboo a bi anki? Ikɔ̈b aki kyanswà, nde kya kyan'fà ken? »
Lalan mpa bàsi ba làkwikilà amu nde. Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Ŋangɔɔm wanswà bàfun'bɛy u nsi ande anà u ywar ande. »
Apan, Yɛsu kàsàkyer anki impà mbɔɔn u bul alan, ntɔn nkɔ̈ɔ̈n a làkwikilà aba.
